1.text: Maze Yesu ajyanwa n'Umwuka mu butayu kugeragezwa n'umwanzi,

2.text: amaze iminsi mirongo ine n'amajoro mirongo ine atarya, abona gusonza.

3.text: Umushukanyi aramwegera aramubwira ati “Niba uri Umwana w'Imana, bwira aya mabuye ahinduke imitsima.”

4.text: Aramusubiza ati “Handitswe ngo ‘Umuntu ntatungwa n'umutsima gusa, ahubwo atungwa n'amagambo yose ava mu kanwa k'Imana.’ ”

5.text: Maze umwanzi amujyana ku murwa wera, amuhagarika ku gasongero k'urusengero

6.text: aramubwira ati “Niba uri Umwana w'Imana, ijugunye hasi kuko handitswe ngo‘Izagutegekera abamarayika bayo,Bakuramire mu maboko yabo,Ngo udakubita ikirenge ku ibuye.’ ”

7.text: Yesu aramusubiza ati “Kandi handitswe ngo ‘Ntukagerageze Uwiteka Imana yawe.’ ”

8.text: Umwanzi arongera amujyana mu mpinga y'umusozi muremure cyane, amwereka ubwami bwose bwo mu isi n'ubwiza bwabwo

9.text: aramubwira ati “Biriya byose ndabiguha nupfukama ukandamya.”

10.text: Yesu aramubwira ati “Genda Satani, kuko handitswe ngo ‘Uramye Uwiteka Imana yawe, abe ari yo ukorera yonyine.’ ”

11.text: Umwanzi aherako aramureka, maze haza abamarayika baramukorera.

12.text: Yesu yumvise ko babohesheje Yohana, aragenda ajya i Galilaya.

13.text: Yimuka i Nazareti atura i Kaperinawumu, umudugudu uri ku nyanja mu rugabano rwa Zebuluni na Nafutali,

14.text: ngo ibyavuzwe n'umuhanuzi Yesaya bisohore ngo

15.text: “Mu gihugu cya Zebuluni na Nafutali,Hafi y'inyanja hakurya ya Yorodani,N'i Galilaya y'abapagani,

16.text: Abantu bari bicaye mu mwijima babonye umucyo mwinshi,kandi abari bicaye mu gihugu cy'urupfu no mu gicucu cyarwo,Bamurikirwa n'umucyo.”

17.text: Yesu ahera ubwo atangira kwigisha avuga ati “Mwihane kuko ubwami bwo mu ijuru buri hafi.”

18.text: Agenda iruhande rw'inyanja y'i Galilaya abona abavandimwe babiri, Simoni witwaga Petero na Andereya mwene se, barobesha urushundura mu nyanja kuko bari abarobyi.

21.text: Yicumye imbere abona abandi bavandimwe babiri, umwe ni Yakobo mwene Zebedayo na Yohana mwene se, bari mu bwato hamwe na se Zebedayo bapfundikanya inshundura zabo, arabahamagara.

22.text: Uwo mwanya basiga ubwato na se, baramukurikira.

23.text: Yesu agenderera ab'i Galilaya hose, abigishiriza mu masinagogi yabo ababwira ubutumwa bwiza bw'ubwami, akiza n'indwara zose n'ubumuga bw'abantu.

24.text: Inkuru ye yamamara i Siriya yose, bamuzanira abarwayi bose n'indembe barwaye indwara zitari zimwe, n'abatewe n'abadayimoni, n'abarwaye ibicuri n'ibirema arabakiza.

25.text: Abantu benshi baramukurikira bavuye i Galilaya n'i Dekapoli, n'i Yerusalemu n'i Yudaya no hakurya ya Yorodani.
